title: Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse size and table sizes
question:
We have created a Lakehouse on Microsoft Fabric. It has a bunch of tables and files.

In the Lakehouse explorer, I can see the files sizes just by clicking on the relevant folder or file in 'Files'.

But, I want to know the size of each table in the 'Tables' section.

How can I do this in a pyspark Notebook? (I'm not very familiar with pyspark)
answer:
You can run the below to get the size of the table in Bytes

spark.sql("describe detail delta-table-name").select("sizeInBytes").collect()
